description: Structured authority policy for HUMMBL agent fleet. Replaces heuristic markdown charter parsing in AuthorityEngine. Gap-9 (issue #414), NIST 800-53 AC-2, AC-5, CM-3.

key_management.scope: Signing identity registry, GPG key generation

authority_revocation.limit: Must post REVOCATION or SUSPENSION notice to bus

github_mutation.scope: Assigned repos, operations within authority charter
github_mutation.limit: Cannot exercise HIGH/CRITICAL without operator DECISION receipt; cannot rotate keys; cannot change org-level settings; cannot remove branch protection

receipt_authoring.limit: Cannot post DECISION type (requires operator principal proof)

review_attestation.limit: Attestation is advisory; does not satisfy human final review
